name: Independent Robotics

seo.title: Independent Robotics | Beringia Marine
seo.description: Making robots useful in the real world. Montreal-based Independent Robotics builds natural-language mission planning (IMPAC), AI robotic-data analytics (Insight Engine), and intelligent autonomous underwater vehicles (Aqua2 / AQ3-LH). NATO DIANA Tech Competition winner. Beringia Marine is their US market representative and US Prime / integration partner for US government programs.

overview.title: Independent Robotics
overview.description: Independent Robotics is a Montreal-based robotics and AI company whose mission is to make robots useful in the real world. A 7–10 person team drawing from Samsung, Google, Clearpath, Locus Robotics, and Adept MobileRobots — and a NATO DIANA Tech Competition winner — they build natural-language mission planning (IMPAC), AI-powered robotic-data analytics (Insight Engine), and intelligent autonomous underwater vehicles (Aqua2 and its successor, the AQ3-LH "Loggerhead"). Beringia Marine serves as their primary US market representative, technical advisor, and US Prime contractor / integration partner for US government programs.

points.title: IMPAC — Semantic Mission Planning with Natural Language
points.description: Speak to robots in plain language to tell them what to do. IMPAC provides semantic mission planning and monitoring as a common interface for any autonomous system — a force multiplier that speeds deployment with low operator overhead.
features: Plan and monitor missions in plain natural language
Common interface for any autonomous system
Integrates with NATO Command and Control standards
Force multiplier: faster deployment, conditional planning, low operator overhead
Example: "Send all drones above 60% battery to patrol the perimeter, the rest should come home and recharge"
Demonstrated controlling a Jackal UGV with natural language

points.title: Insight Engine — AI Analytics for Robotic Data
points.description: A SaaS cloud platform: upload data, configure analysis pipelines, and view results. A proprietary AI algorithm identifies related objects with little or no training, and works with any robotic data feed — aerial, underwater, or ground. NATO DIANA Tech Competition winner.
features: Upload data, configure pipelines, view results in the cloud
Proprietary AI identifies related objects with little or no training
Works with any robotic data feed: aerial, underwater, ground
Outputs: PDF, CSV, API, dashboards & alerts
Reports: object identification + location, damage assessments, heat maps, industry-standard formats
NATO DIANA Tech Competition Winner
Demonstrated FGVC accuracy gain from 17% to 77% baseline; 77–83% top-1 and 90%+ top-3 on military-vehicle subtypes

points.title: Aqua2 — Intelligent Underwater Autonomy
points.description: World-leading autonomy for high-fidelity 3D surveying, monitoring, and inspection. An onboard GPU brings edge AI to the cloud-denied underwater domain, and the vehicle is rapid, single-person deployable. Available for purchase now.
features: World-leading autonomy for high-fidelity 3D surveying, monitoring, inspection
Onboard GPU for edge AI in the cloud-denied underwater domain
Rapid single-person deployable (Pelican Air 1607 carry-case)
Unique quiet acoustic profile — near-silent operation
Built in Canada for winter / arctic deployment
Flexible sensor payload with standard protocols
Available for purchase now

points.title: AQ3-LH (Project Loggerhead) — Next-Generation Aqua2
points.description: The successor to Aqua2, developed with Canada's Ocean Supercluster: improved depth rating, maneuverability, and payload at reduced cost with streamlined deployment. Built for arctic operation. Ready for pilots now; general release scheduled 2027.
features: Developed with Canada's Ocean Supercluster
Improved depth-rating, maneuverability, and payload
Reduced cost and streamlined deployment
Built for arctic deployment
Ready for pilots now; general release scheduled 2027

useCases.title: Target Markets
useCases.description: Independent Robotics' platforms serve US and allied defense, commercial underwater operations, and robotic-data analytics across domains — brought to the US market by Beringia Marine.

cases.title: Port, Harbor & Naval-Base Security
cases.description: Autonomous monitoring for ports, harbors, and naval-base force protection.

cases.title: Robotic Data Analytics

valueProposition.title: Beringia's Role in the Partnership

Customer development with US defense end-users and program offices
Technical advisory: sensor evaluation, system architecture, integration planning
Identification of US technology partners, hardware suppliers, and research institutions
ITAR-compliant US program access via Beringia-held prime contracts
